_note: Source-grounded entry for EQUIDERMA AI. Unsupported fields are intentionally null or empty.
description: Dryness of the skin caused by reduced water content in the outer skin layer.
causes: Frequent washing or exposure to soaps and detergents

appearance.general: Dry, rough, scaly skin with fine fissuring in more severe areas.

general_first_aid: Avoid very hot water and harsh soaps or detergents.
prevention: Limit prolonged exposure to hot water and harsh cleansers.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss persistent dryness, fissuring, severe itch, or a possible underlying skin/systemic condition if symptoms do not improve.
